summary: Plant at least 22 Banana Trees under an Orchard right away (7 days to mature), then put two Smoothie Stands near the houses. Villagers drink Smoothies on their own for Wellness (4 units each), so 100 drinks follow from enough fruit; Palm Trees also give coconuts to the Foragers' Hut.

build_order.note: 9 of the 10 starting Logs; Planks for everything else.
Plant 26 or so: 22 count for the objective and spares cover losses. One fruit every 3 to 3.7 days each.
Two needed, 6 Planks + 4 Logs each, near houses.
Happiness (optional): plaza, playground, Zen Garden and Fitness Park cover Community, Fun and Wellness.

pitfalls: Smoothies raise Wellness, not Cooling; heat waves quadruple how fast Cooling falls for two days, so keep shade and housing in mind separately.
Count only matured Banana Trees once the objective ticks; check whether saplings count.
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
